lines.trans: Vika, my dear, please forgive me!
I made a terrible mistake, I am guilty.
I love you very much!
Let us start everything from the very beginning.
Pasha, where is my money?
What money? What are you talking about?
The money that you stole from the nightstand.
I did not take anything from your nightstand!
Only you knew about this hiding place.
Where did you put them, answer me!
Vikusya, calm down, let us talk calmly.
Do not touch me until you return the money!

meanings.note: 'брать' alone often means this, in talk about officials

examples.trans: We have to take all the money.

вернуть.gloss: to give back, to get back

meanings.note: short forms виноват / виновата / виноваты are used for 'it's my/your fault'

examples.text: Я ни в чём не виноват.
examples.trans: I'm not to blame for anything.

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: plural only: there is no singular in everyday use

examples.trans: The money is on the table.

meanings.en: to put, do with, dispose of (colloquial)
meanings.note: Куда ты дел...? = Where did you put / What did you do with...?

examples.text: Куда ты дел их деньги на новое здание?
examples.trans: Where did you put their money for the new building?
Where did I put the keys?

meanings.note: to a loved one, and at the start of letters
+ genitive: 'из мэрии' = from the town hall
in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!
joins a description to a noun; agrees with that noun in gender and number

examples.trans: This is a mayor who keeps his word.
Where is the book that was here?

meanings.note: for movement; где is for location

examples.trans: I love our town very much.
At the beginning of the week.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
usually in the genitive ничего, with не: ничего не осталось
+ prepositional; об before a vowel: об этом

meanings.en: to answer, to reply, to pick up the phone

examples.text: Я вам звоню, а вы не отвечаете!
examples.trans: I call you, and you don't answer!

examples.text: Почему ты не отвечаешь на мои вопросы?
examples.trans: Why aren't you answering my questions?
I love our town very much.

meanings.en: to have a talk, to speak (with someone)

meanings.note: as a conjunction: пока я сплю
+ instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми
forms the superlative: самый главный = the most important

examples.trans: The most important thing is the people.
The wind is blowing hard outside.

meanings.note: a formal, bookish verb; used jokingly about everyday things
совершить ошибку = to make a mistake

examples.trans: Daddy's already had his cold dip.

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: What a horrible person you are!

meanings.en: to calm down, to settle down

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
